title: Membership
description: PROVISIONAL (pending founder WhatsApp handoff, 2026-08-12). One person's belonging to one Space, with the role they hold there and the institutional identity (roll number, registration number) they carry alongside their personal identity.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

personId.description: Id of the person who belongs to the space.

spaceId.description: Id of the Space the person belongs to.

role.description: The role held in this space. Minimal invented set (students first, per founder intent); adding values is a minor bump.

rollNumber.description: The roll number as the institution issues it, kept verbatim (formats vary widely across Indian colleges).

registrationNumber.description: University registration/enrolment number, where distinct from the roll number.

admissionYear.description: Year of admission, where the identity carries one.

institutionalIdentity.description: Identity the institution assigned to this person, carried alongside (never instead of) their personal identity.

joinedAt.description: When the person joined this space (ISO 8601).

leftAt.description: When the person left this space, if they have (ISO 8601). Absent means the membership is current.
